description: This Java source file defines the class StandardClojureEngine, which implements a service engine for executing services written in Clojure within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load Clojure namespaces and invoke Clojure functions, handling integration between Java and Clojure code.

classes.name: StandardClojureEngine
classes.description: A service engine implementation that enables the execution of Clojure-based services within the OFBiz framework. Handles loading Clojure namespaces and invoking Clojure functions, integrating seamlessly with OFBiz service infrastructure.

methods.name: callClojure
methods.description: Loads a Clojure namespace and calls a specified Clojure function, passing the DispatchContext and context map as parameters. Handles reflection and integration with Clojure code.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, ignoring the result, by delegating to runSync.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a Clojure-based service synchronously and returns the result as a Map, or throws an exception if the result is invalid.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the specified Clojure service function, handling context and error checking, and managing reflection-based invocation.
